label: An infinite regress is impossible among efficient causes that are PER_SE_1 required for an effect…
paraphrase: An infinite regress is impossible among efficient causes that are per se required for an effect (stone, stick, hand), but not among causes multiplied per accidens (successive hammers, human generation).
